notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental beginning/ending_cash are the fund balances the governmental funds statement rolls forward (695,792 -> 1,103,957, p5); they include county treasurer cash, due from/to other funds and restricted investments. Transfers in 216,817 is the printed net governmental transfer; business-type transfers net (219,575): the 2,758 difference is printed as total transfers on the Statement of Activities (p3). Business-type uses the proprietary funds statement (p7), measure net position (includes capital assets and bonds); the government-wide SNP business-type column (305,632) is on a different cash basis. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis, Total column (p1). The only supplementary schedule is the all-funds budgetary comparison (p10, includes a Nursing Home 5,157,107 not in the statements), so detail is per fund column of the governmental (p5) and proprietary (p7) statements; the combined budget schedule is not recorded. proprietary null (cash basis report; cash flow statement on p8). Read pages 1-10 of 10
